technology_name: Liquid Organic Fertilizer from Coconut Leaf Vermicompost
problem_solved: Sustainable recycling of coconut leaf biomass
description: Kalpa Vermiwash is a liquid organic fertilizer extracted from the active vermicomposting of coconut leaves. The fertilizer is diluted before application and can be used for field and horticultural crops, particularly vegetables
applications:
Organic fertilizer and bio-input manufacturing companies
Vegetable cultivation and horticulture enterprises
Organic farming and sustainable agriculture initiatives
Agricultural cooperatives and farmer producer organizations (FPOs)
Nursery, landscaping, and protected cultivation sectors
